links.comparator_used: Standard consent form currently in use (A), left unchanged
links.outcome: Healthcare professionals' ratings of adequacy, comprehensibility, completeness and overall judgement
links.effect: Median adequacy 4.0 for both the standard form (A) and the ChatGPT-modified standard form (C). Overall judgement median 4.0 for A and C. Both received the top scores in every category.
links.tradeoff: The consent form generated entirely by ChatGPT (B) scored lowest (median 3.0 for adequacy and overall judgement). The authors conclude that the best results come when ChatGPT is combined with human knowledge and supervision.
links.quote: Consent forms A and C achieved the top scores in every category; consent form B obtained the lowest score.

design_hint: human expert review/editing of LLM-generated consent forms
